214. Wrongful obstruction of certain officers.—

—   Any person who prevents the Chief 
Executive Officer or the Secretary or any person to whom such officer has lawfully 
delegated his powers from entering on or into any place, building or land, from exercising 
his lawful power of entering thereon or, therein shall, on conviction, be punished with 
simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one month or with fine which may 
extend to five hundred rupees or with both.
